lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Short-term investments
lines.why: Securities held for the cash they will return: financial.

lines.name: Receivables
lines.why: Owed by customers for sales: operating.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Goodwill
lines.why: Paid for acquired businesses: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Deferred tax assets
lines.why: Taxes on operating income paid ahead: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current assets
lines.why: Other long-term operating items: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Accrued compensation
lines.why: Wages, bonuses and benefits earned but not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Deferred revenue
lines.why: Customers' payments ahead of delivery: operating.

lines.name: Income taxes payable
lines.why: Taxes on operating income: operating.

lines.name: Current portion of long-term debt
lines.why: Borrowed money falling due within a year: financial.

lines.name: Long-term debt
lines.why: Bonds, notes and loans: financial.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Income taxes payable, non-current
lines.why: Taxes on operating income due after a year (often uncertain tax positions): operating.

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Deferred revenue, non-current
lines.why: Customers' payments for later years: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities
lines.why: Other long-term operating obligations: operating.

lines.name: Other current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current assets minus the current lines above: current assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current assets (total assets − current assets) minus the non-current lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current liabilities minus the current lines above: current liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current liabilities (total liabilities − current liabilities) minus the non-current lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

We deliver trusted, connected financial data, software applications, advanced analytics, and AI-powered solutions embedded in the critical workflows that finance professionals rely on every day.

While we do not believe we are dependent on any one of our intellectual property rights, we do rely on the combination of intellectual property rights and other measures to protect our proprietary rights.

We and the third-party service providers we rely on for certain critical functions are subject to system failures, security breaches and cyber-attacks - including those sponsored by nation-states, terrorist organizations, or others seeking to illicitly obtain technology or intellectual property - as well as to fraud or malice by employees or vendors, human error, software or hardware failures, and the risks associated with our use of mobile and cloud technologies.
Our clients rely on us for the delivery of time-sensitive, accurate, complete and up-to-date data and applications.

In addition, in remote work environments, the daily activities and productivity of our workforce are now more closely tied to key vendors consistently delivering their services without material disruption.

Our business, and in particular our growth and our increasing use of AI, depends on access to data center capacity, power and computing resources, including specialized hardware, whether provided through our own facilities or, increasingly, through third-party cloud and data center providers.

Advances in generative and agentic AI can lower the cost, time and technical expertise required to aggregate and analyze data and to build software, and may make it increasingly feasible for our clients and other third parties to develop their own tools, interfaces and workflows, or to rely on lower-cost or more generalized AI applications, in place of our offerings.

Further, decision on the part of large institutional clients to purchase our products and services often requires management-level sponsorship and typically depend upon the size of the client, with larger clients having more complex and time-consuming purchasing processes.

As a result, our future success will continue to depend upon our ability to identify and develop new products and enhancements that address the future needs of our target markets and to respond to their changing standards and practices.

We rely on third-party vendors, partners and service providers for a range of critical functions, including cloud hosting and infrastructure, data and content, software, connectivity, and certain operational and business processes, and our reliance on such third parties, including partners, is increasing.
Certain content sets that we rely on have a limited number of suppliers, although we make an effort to have alternative sources available, where reasonable.
Determining our tax obligations requires significant judgment and relies on estimates and assumptions.
Our ability to meet our payment and other obligations under our debt depends on our ability to generate sufficient cash flow in the future.

We also actively engage with key vendors, industry participants, and intelligence and law enforcement communities as part of our continuing efforts to evaluate and enhance the effectiveness of our information security policies and procedures.
Future cash dividend payments are subject to final determination by our Board of Directors and will depend on our earnings, capital requirements, financial condition and other relevant factors.
The ultimate number of common shares that may be earned pursuant to our PSU awards depends on the level of our achievement of stated financial performance objectives.
